pick.title: Choose paths automatically
pick.description: On - paths of data centers are measured at start and every 6 hours. Paths set below take priority.

domains.title: Spare domains
domains.description: Domains behind Cloudflare that lead to Telegram, best first. Used when the domain of the output does not answer.

routes.title: Paths of data centers
routes.description: One line per data center: «2 ws domain» - through this domain, «4 direct» - not intercepted. «m» after the number is the media data center: «2m direct».

dc_addresses.title: More data center addresses
dc_addresses.description: Addresses of Telegram data centers in addition to the built-in table: «address[/mask] number [media]».

warp.title: WARP tunnels
warp.description: Interfaces of WARP tunnels with an exit abroad, best first. The bridge tries them before other paths and leaves a tunnel that does not connect.

verbose.title: Log every connection
verbose.description: Off - the log keeps the start parameters and path changes only.
